svg.title: Where to hang a Bayu Dense node
svg.desc: Placement guide in pictograms: side elevation on a wall and on a post with heights and clearances, a section through the enclosure with the PM intake and exhaust, a compound site plan with 5 m rings around smoke and heat sources, the first-week co-location, and do and do-not cards.

g.text: Bayu Dense · where to hang it
Outside, in the shade, 1.5 to 3 m up, 5 m from anything that makes smoke or heat.
section through the case, not to scale
Then move it to its own spot.
For real air temperature, an SHT40
! Measuring one of these on purpose, a kitchen or a coil room? Then go close, and write it in the node's name.
